description: This file defines a Razor Page model class for editing catalog items within an ASP.NET Core web application. It handles GET requests to display a catalog item and POST requests to update it, utilizing a service interface for business logic.

classes.name: EditCatalogItemModel
classes.description: Razor Page model for editing catalog items, including authorization, data binding, GET and POST request handling.

methods.name: EditCatalogItemModel
methods.description: Constructor injecting the catalog item service.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests by setting the CatalogModel from provided view model.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles POST requests, updating the catalog item if the model state is valid, then redirects to the admin index page.
